targets.rawSql: SELECT q.run_id AS run_id, count() AS questions, round(avg(e.em), 3) AS em, round(avg(e.f1), 3) AS f1, countIf(q.all_http_200 AND e.em = 0) AS ok200_wrong, countIf(e.failure_type = 'wrong_retrieval') AS wrong_retrieval, countIf(e.failure_type = 'wrong_reasoning') AS wrong_reasoning, countIf(e.failure_type = 'correct_memorized') AS memorized FROM mart_run_question AS q INNER JOIN mart_eval AS e ON q.run_id = e.run_id AND q.question_id = e.question_id GROUP BY q.run_id ORDER BY q.run_id DESC
